comments.author: @nnonotnow
comments.text: This is a painful but accurate look at the 'hollowing out' of data-heavy, entry-level roles. It’s not that AI is 'taking over' every job, but it is certainly compressing teams by automating the repetitive information-processing tasks that used to require a 10-person department. The reality is that we're moving toward a model where fewer people manage much more powerful tools. The fear-mongering about it wiping out every career—from healthcare to the trades—is a massive stretch, but we shouldn't downplay the very real shift happening right now in white-collar recruiting and admin work.
